# Shoolin Textiles
> Premium wholesale supplier of Indian Batik, Mulmul cotton batik, and handcrafted traditional cotton batik direct from Jaipur to boutiques worldwide.

## About
Shoolin Textiles focuses on authenticity, supplying high-fidelity premium Indian Batik Sarees featuring classic motifs, vibrant hues, and modern interpretations. We specialize in bulk exports to Sri Lanka and globally. Our materials include premium Mulmul Cotton, characterized by soft, airy tropical comfort.

## Key Offerings & Keywords
- Batik saree
- Indian Batik
- Mulmul cotton batik
- Premium batik exporter
- Jaipur batik wholesale
- Cotton batik Bagru
